feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Poundland boss urges staff to feel pride in turnaround efforts
articles.summary: Poundland's boss has told staff to feel proud of their efforts to revitalise the discount retailer despite its collapse into administration earlier this week.

articles.title: MPs to probe role of private equity on high street after Poundland collapse
articles.summary: The role of private equity firms in reshaping Britain's high streets is to be probed by parliament after the collapse of Poundland this week put more than 10,000 jobs at risk.

articles.title: Centrica warns on jobs after government snubs Rough gas storage deal
articles.summary: The FTSE-100 utility Centrica has warned that hundreds of jobs at its Rough gas storage facility off the Yorkshire coast are at risk and claimed that ministers had rejected proposals to bolster Britain's energy security.

articles.title: Amazon staff to strike and rally on busiest weekend of the year
articles.summary: Amazon employees around the world are set to stage protests on Black Friday amid claims of unfair pay and oppressive working conditions.

articles.title: Airline suspends all flights - as carrier faces bankruptcy
articles.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights, with the company saying it could file for bankruptcy unless an urgent solution to its finances is found.

articles.title: Crest Nicholson chair to step down amid urgent lender talks
articles.summary: The chairman of Crest Nicholson, one of Britain's biggest housebuilders, is preparing to step down amid urgent talks with its lenders aimed at fortifying its troubled balance sheet.

articles.title: Channel 4 in talks to sell London HQ to property group Socius
articles.summary: Channel 4, the state-owned broadcaster, is in talks to sell its long-standing London base to the developer of a landmark 'cancer district' elsewhere in the capital.

articles.title: Dubai wholesaler plans renewed bid for collapsed Poundland
articles.summary: The Dubai-based businessman who emerged as a suitor for Poundland days before its collapse into insolvency is planning a fresh bid to buy the retailer out of administration.

articles.title: Major US tech index comes close to crashing into a bear market
articles.summary: A tech-heavy index on Wall Street briefly teetered into bear market territory on Wednesday - as AI-exposed stocks continue to face heavy sell-offs.

articles.title: Poundland insolvency: What went wrong and what next?
articles.summary: Poundland's collapse into administration was the outcome feared most by staff in the run-up to Christmas - and the government too.
